name: Data Centre PUE Benchmarks
description: 104 publicly disclosed data centre Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE) figures, each traced to its publisher: Google's global fleet and 35 campuses (trailing 12 months to Q2 2026, plus year-end fleet history 2017-2025), Amazon Web Services' global average and 27 cloud regions (2025), Microsoft's global and regional PUE (FY24, FY25), Equinix and Digital Realty portfolio PUE, the Uptime Institute global survey average 2007-2025, the European Commission's 2024 EU average from Energy Efficiency Directive reporting, IDC estimates as quoted by AWS, and the NLR ESIF data centre. Every value is copied exactly as published, with source URL, period, period type, measurement scope and retrieval date (10 October 2026). Access. Interactive version with a PUE calculator (facility ÷ IT energy, measurement category, EnEfG and EU comparisons): greencalculus.com/calculators/data-centre-pue-calculator/. Source repository and build script: github.com/greencalculus/data-centre-pue-benchmarks. This deposit is a frozen edition; cite it for reproducibility, or cite the concept DOI for the latest version. Read before comparing. Figures are not like for like: fleet trailing-12-month PUE, survey averages, regulatory averages, design values and estimates are distinguished in the metric and period_type columns. Most publishers do not state where they meter IT energy (UPS output, PDU output or IT equipment input), which changes the result.
